reason: My architect already hands me renders as part of their fee, so I'm not paying a second outfit to model the same plans. Every time a client moves a wall I'd be burning revision rounds and waiting on someone else's turnaround.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? Two revision rounds ends fast on a custom job, and I already get 3D from my architect inside their fee.
would_change_my_mind: Unlimited revisions at a flat price with a same-day turnaround, on a job where my architect isn't producing any 3D.
